primary: Lowest held-out task-macro GT action MSE across all 35 tasks, with all four primary suites and DLC separately reported.
teacher_tiebreak: Consider other candidates only when the paired 95% episode-bootstrap interval of their aggregate GT difference includes zero and no primary suite has a 95% interval wholly above zero versus the GT leader. Among these candidates choose minimum fixed-reliability teacher agreement MSE.
uncertainty_caveat: A non-significant difference is inconclusive, not proof that candidates are equivalent. Any selected GT/teacher tradeoff must be shown explicitly before recovery.
teacher_weights: Computed only from teacher versus GT and the fixed zero-action baseline/component checks; identical across candidates.
fit_data: Used for overfitting and consistency diagnostics, not candidate ranking.
task_regressions: Report every task and components; do not hide them in the aggregate.
